tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search public IARCCUM documents by title, description, and indexed full text. Embargoed records are never returned.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Return structured metadata and public items for one released IARCCUM document.

tools.name: search_names
tools.description: Search person and named-body authority records by name components, dates, acronym, ISNI, Wikidata ID, and variant name.

tools.name: get_name
tools.description: Return one public authority record with public hierarchy and relationship data. Private contact fields are excluded.

tools.name: search_organisations
tools.description: Search authority records marked as IARCCUM organisations/fonds.

tools.name: find_documents_by_protocol
tools.description: Find public documents by archive protocol number, ranking exact matches before partial matches.

tools.name: get_related_documents
tools.description: Find public documents explicitly linked to a document in the archive relationship table.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search events by title, location, description, participants, and optional dates.
